name: cronometer-mcp
description: Your Cronometer diary, nutrition with honest coverage, and safe writes.
long_description:
Reads and writes your Cronometer diary through Cronometer's mobile app interface: foods with ids, targets and what remains today, exercise, notes, biometrics, fasting, custom foods and recipes. Nutrition summaries are computed food by food, so a nutrient a food does not report is shown as missing rather than silently counted as zero. Every write asks for approval.

Cronometer has no public API; this uses the same private interfaces as its app and website. That is unofficial and may break, and Cronometer could restrict an account it sees automated. Not affiliated with Cronometer.

username.title: Cronometer email
username.description: The email you sign in to Cronometer with.

password.title: Cronometer password
password.description: Kept by Claude Desktop in your operating system's credential store.

totp_secret.title: Two-factor key (optional)
totp_secret.description: Only if your account uses an authenticator app: the base32 key shown when two-factor was set up.

timezone.title: Diary timezone
timezone.description: IANA name such as America/New_York. Leave blank to use this computer's.

accept_risk.title: I understand this uses Cronometer's unofficial interfaces
accept_risk.description: It may break, and Cronometer could restrict an account it sees automated. Required for live access.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Offer no tool that can change the account.
